realms.name: The Heavens (An)
realms.description: The sky/heaven, the realm of An (the sky god), Enlil (the storm/air god), Marduk (the Babylonian supreme god), Nanna (the moon), and Utu (the sun) [S1][S5].

realms.name: The Earth (Ki)
realms.description: The earth, the realm of the human world and the earth-gods (Ninhursag, the 'earth-mother') [S5].

realms.name: The Underworld (Irkallu / Kur)
realms.description: The underworld, the realm of the dead, the domain of Ereshkigal (the queen of the underworld) and Nergal (the underworld-god) [S4][S5].

structure_notes: The Mesopotamian cosmos is three-layered: the Heavens (An) above, the Earth (Ki) in the middle, and the Underworld (Irkallu/Kur) below. The 'Apsu' (the fresh water) and the 'Tiamat' (the salt water) are the two primeval waters that underlie the world [S1][S5]. This is a scholarly reconstruction from Sumerian and Babylonian texts [S5].
